audit_subject: CARL-DX Final Blind Run Memory Provenance Forensic Audit

provenance_reconciliation.question_1_source_of_120_memories: Created at runtime in memory during the 120 simulation ticks due to a false-positive collision flag condition (sensory.ncon > 4).
provenance_reconciliation.question_6_zero_memory_emergence_verdict: VERIFIED_WITH_LIMITATIONS (Agent began with 0 pre-seeded memories, but accumulated 120 false-positive negative collision episodes during runtime due to floor contact counting).

technical_root_cause.physics_reality: In MuJoCo, data.ncon counts ALL contacts in the entire world (including floor contact of all cubes, spheres, and hazards in the arena, totaling 19 contacts). Thus sensory.ncon > 4 was True on every tick.
technical_root_cause.serialization_artifact: In scratch/run_final_integrated_blind_test.py, len(agent.memory.episodes) was evaluated post-simulation when serializing decision_trace.jsonl, stamping 120 on every row instead of recording the cumulative runtime count at each tick.
